author: Gordon Thelander
releaseNotes:
Test build 1.6.2. Installs alongside the release version; your existing install is untouched.

LEGEND: the legend now draws the same shapes the map does. An app was drawn as a circle when the map draws a square, and the external-system diamond was a rotated circle, which is a circle. Added the missing Device, paused/disabled and rule-target entries, and pause/resume no longer looks identical to stops.

LEGEND: click the header to fold it away. The choice is remembered.

FIX: the shared registry is now a 37KB file built for the app rather than the 165KB one built for people. The old one was too big to fetch and parse in a single Hubitat execution, so it failed silently and the panel then claimed it had never been fetched. It now says when a fetch failed, and a failed fetch no longer strands the whole scan.

Reports welcome on the community thread.
